item.title: 2 states approved permanent standard time. Others are hoping to do the same
item.description: Two states didn't "spring forward" an hour on Sunday. More than a dozen others are vying to join them in locking the clocks on year-round standard time.

item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
